title: Who was in Milwaukee: Cass, Bernie Young, Abernathy
summary: The interviewer asks about Milwaukee musicians. Levy cannot recall some and places Abernathy with Jabbo and later with Wickliffe.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You mentioned Cass. Do you recall now any of the other fellows there?
Yes, I think he was. Yes, he was around there.
Had Leonard Gay come into Milwaukee yet? No. He later came later. And you said that Bernie Young was not playing the group. No. He was around Milwaukee at that time.
I think he was. I'm pretty sure he was.
Abernathy, the trombone player? Yeah. I think he was with us with Jabo, if I'm not mistaken.
I thought he might have been.
Yes, you know, he came later on with Wycliffe's band.
